description: This file is a shell script designed for testing Git pack corruption resilience. It contains functions to create test files, simulate pack corruption, and run various test scenarios verifying the robustness of Git’s object storage against corruptions. The script includes detailed test cases with setup, corruption, and recovery validation.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Creates test files with random content and specific markings to simulate object data for tests.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, creates objects from test files, packs them, and verifies the pack.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Recreates the pack files, possibly corrupting them to simulate errors.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Corrupts a specific object within the pack file to test recovery mechanisms.
